title: PAPER_CLAIM_AUDIT.json - paper-claim consistency self-check
description: Produced by /paper-writing Step 5 self-review. No explicit JSON example exists in the docs, so this schema requires only what is actually promised: the 6-state audit verdict, audited_input_hashes (artifact-registry.md schema invariant 2), and the aigc_scan field that writing-principles.md section 0.5 writes its results into. FAIL reason codes promised by the docs include insufficient_evidence_as_finding, negative_result_as_contribution, shrinkage_only_response, aigc_phrasing, report_style, missing_reproducibility_statement.

audited_input_hashes.description: SHA256 of every consumed file (paper .tex files, CLAIMS_FROM_RESULTS.md, ...) per artifact-registry.md schema invariant 2.

aigc_scan.description: Anti-AIGC scan results (writing-principles.md section 0.5): blacklisted-phrase counts per class (any class >= 6 -> FAIL aigc_phrasing), sentence-length variance per section (std < 5 words -> WARN sentence_monotony), report-style spot check (Intro/Discussion all report-style -> FAIL report_style), dash count (> 5 -> WARN). Internal shape is not fixed by the docs, so contents are unconstrained.
